source: Explicit public didactic data, not measurements

axes.scale: Three learner-provided labels at equal screen intervals; nonzero equal exact numerical differences; endpoints must include zero and the complete reference data range. Scaling belongs to C01/C02. Any such linear scale is accepted independent of pixel position.
axes.direction: Both increasing and explicitly labelled decreasing axes are accepted: the affine coordinate mapping is invertible and preserves numerical distances. No reversal penalty.
axes.empty: No preselected quantity/unit/ticks and no points.

points.matching: Order-independent one-to-one matching in data coordinates. Five points required; duplicate matches and extra points incorrect. Missing/incomplete coordinates partial, unknown format clarify. Correct individual decisions remain visible.
points.boundary: Tolerances apply also at zero and extrema; a value just outside the reference axis endpoints can still be within tolerance and is drawn in the plot margin. Out-of-view points remain in the editable coordinate list and are explicitly reported.
points.pointer: Same semantic raw coordinate strings as keyboard. Pointer inverse affine transform rounded to 0.001 mol/L and 0.1 percentage points, disclosed in UI; never snap to reference points. Recheck with pure assessor.
points.lines: Scatter points only; no inferred line or model law.

aggregation: Known incorrect > clarify > partial; all empty neutral, mixture of correct and empty partial; green only all required decisions correct.
context: Exact versioned material and immutable binding; edits/help/reset invalidate results; aid provenance monotonic; solution shown separately, never inserted into learner answer; writing ungraded; no raw answers persisted/transmitted.
limits: No independent specialist acceptance or real-device test claimed
